status: No material method blocker to separately freezing a development evaluation; no empirical improvement or admission conclusion.

problem_fit.temporary_execution: Q2 permits prospective weight adjustments and review. The four scaled destinations are temporary executions of the existing strategic target, not a new persistent Q1 menu or fourth investment product. A temporary all-bill protective proposal at m=0 remains an allocation among the same three asset classes.
problem_fit.benefit_and_cost: A growth trade with support-feasible hold still needs a strictly positive paired expected log-wealth advantage after exact fees. If hold is infeasible, growth may be sacrificed for a declared prospective support-risk benefit; protection is not claimed to earn positive financial growth. Report fees, sacrificed growth, residual risk and ensuing Review explicitly.
problem_fit.risk_tolerance: Original L remains the drawdown tolerance and original floor is not relaxed. The formula does not turn the question into a capital guarantee or replace observed running maximum drawdown by current drawdown.

mathematical_check.formula: m=clip((R-(1-L)*P)/(L*R),0,1), for 0<L<=1; R=current real wealth, P=historical real peak.
mathematical_check.drawdown_form: For d=1-R/P, m=clip((L-d)/(L*(1-d)),0,1). For 0<L<1, the unclipped derivative with respect to d is (L-1)/(L*(1-d)^2)<=0.
mathematical_check.units_and_boundaries: m is invariant to common positive scaling of R/P, equals1 at peak and0 at the original floor for0=P for the L=0 scale1 convention; a tolerated R
mathematical_check.proposal: For each fixed a in[1,.75,.5,.25], proposal=a*m*w+(1-a*m)*e_bill. It is nonnegative and sums to1. Its equity-plus-bond share is a*m*(w_equity+w_bond), not m.
mathematical_check.fee_geometry: The full destination is executed by the same exact transaction solver. Partial post-dollar segment y(q)=x+q*(y_star-x), fee(q)=q*fee_star, and all joint-support floor constraints remain unchanged; scaling destination weights does not scale or omit the fee.
mathematical_check.information: m uses only the current pre-action R/P/L. Current realized market and future suffix are absent from the pure decision arguments. The training forecast and support information sets are unchanged.
mathematical_check.initial_and_review: Initial m is1 and requires full original target or Review/financial NULL. Already-breached or pending accounts do not restart. The unchanged V2b fallback is imported directly and is followed by absorbing Review.

essential_nonclaims: The new four-destination family replaces the old family; it is not a superset. A former growth or feasible point may disappear. There is no monotone improvement theorem for feasibility, coverage, growth, fees or realized risk.

m limits new proposal destinations only. Separate hold may retain higher exposure; partial execution may also exceed a destination exposure. Unscaled V2b mitigation endpoints may carry more risk than the scaled primary proposals.
This is not a compulsory hold-exposure cap, CPPI insurance, recursive viability guarantee, future-support containment argument or intrayear drawdown guarantee.
Real bill returns can be below1, and transaction fees consume wealth. Even m=0 does not guarantee feasibility or restoration of the original floor.

Primary support feasibility concerns the declared finite training one-step support. It does not certify real predictive calibration or all future scenarios. Fallback retains support_feasible=False and does not restore ordinary autonomous service.
m is a deterministic normative architecture using client tolerance, not an estimated psychological preference or newly identified risk-aversion parameter.

synthetic_evidence_reviewed.covered: At-peak/initial equality to old rules; mathematical boundaries; exact partial execution; added safe point and lost old growth-point counterexamples; hold above proposal exposure; m0 infeasibility with negative real bills; direct fallback identity; absorbing Review/original H; actual-breach bypass; prefix information; readonly witnesses.
synthetic_evidence_reviewed.scope: Handmade tests validate implementation examples and invariants, not market efficacy.

empirical_questions_for_frozen_developme: Run the complete own-training nested learner with unchanged six families and selector; retain old V2/V2b negative outcomes and exploratory version chronology.
Report all original IDs, initial financial coverage, time to first funded referral, ordinary autonomous continuity, residual risk after mitigation and full-H pending wealth separately.

Compare net full-H growth and MDD mean/CVaR/events against each same-funded-ID benchmark while retaining all-original benchmark summaries. Include costs and actual trading; do not select a favorable comparator.
Inspect re-risking delay, loss ratcheting and turnover induced by reactive m. Any empirical gain must survive fees and cannot be inferred from smaller proposal exposures alone.
Do not use the historically seen final60 to choose or adjust this architecture. New development results remain exploratory evidence, even when outer folds are numerically audited.
decision: Accept as a coherent, explicitly limited next structural hypothesis. Freeze new source/protocol before any actual development execution. This review changes no old model, label, target or readiness flag.
